Tara (CS): FYI — Spruce wants to roll a personalization pilot into two more product squads in June. Asking for realtime summaries + per-session embeddings. Could be a launch-time spike.

Liam (Spruce - PM): correct. plan is phased rollout over 2 weeks. baseline ~30 rps, expected 180-220 rps bursts for 10-20m when sessions start. summary payloads ~450-650 tokens, embed calls ~50-80 tokens. Need 95p latency under ~500ms for UI paths.

Kofi (CS Ops): numbers help. would recommend hybrid: hosted for steady-state, small reserved pool for bursts. any PII concerns?

Liam (Spruce - PM): yes, user messages include PII. require KMS + audit logs and SSO.

Marta (Solutions Eng): draft ops notes:
- canary on hosted with prefix caching
- pre-warmed dedicated nodes for burst windows
- KV cache for session summaries
- separate routing for heavy summarization vs quick embeds
Sample canary snippet:
{"route":"/summaries","canary_pct":10,"burst_threshold_rps":120,"fallback":"/summaries-hosted"}

task-bot: added checklist item: "Spruce payloads + security classification" :white_check_mark:

Ben (AE): I'll arrange a 45-min technical prep next Tue; we need sanitized payloads and a first-pass cost estimate for their leadership by Friday.

Tara (CS): Action items: Liam to share sanitized payloads (Tue), Marta to send pilot topology + cost delta (Wed), Kofi to schedule prep call (Mon). Marking as expansion lead and renewal-watch if pilot stalls.

Liam (Spruce - PM): will post examples after the prep. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
